items.name: Remaining performance obligations, June 30, 2026
items.claim: Satellogic's remaining performance obligations as of June 30, 2026 totaled $80.7 million.
items.source_excerpt: Remaining performance obligations as of June 30, 2026 totaled $80.7 million, with $45.8 million expected to be recognized as revenue within one year, $9.3 million in years one to two, $7.2 million in years two to three, and $18.4 million thereafter.

notes: Both queued investor-relations pages returned HTTP 403 and stored no text; the RPO item instead comes from the stored Q2 2026 8-K exhibit, which discloses total RPO with its expected recognition schedule.
